derivation: by simp only [kerProj, nonSingular_ker_bot, HermitianMat.ext_iff]; simp [projector, Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto_bot]
explanation: Mathlib proves that the orthogonal projection onto the bottom submodule is zero. After nonSingular_ker_bot reduces A.ker to ⊥, unfolding projector and translating its matrix representation gives the stated HermitianMat equality. The existing simp-based proof uses this Mathlib fact.
